mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline over 3 months fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >40% of instances or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
